package external_pilot

import rego.v1

default allow := false

allow if {
    input.action == "POST /api/resource/Sales Order"
    input.resource.id == "ERPNext:16.0.0"
    input.trusted.customerDisabled == false
}
reason: Source VIS-FSV-B17-01 states that sales orders can be disallowed against a customer via the 'Disabled' flag. Runtime ABI declares /trusted/customerDisabled (boolean) representing this server-side state and /request/body/customer (string) as the referenced customer. The focused target constraint is: deny sales order creation when the customer is disabled. Policy checks action, resource.id against organization schema, and that customerDisabled is false.
